PORTFOLIO OS — MERGE REVIEW PACK FOR GEMINI ARGON

Branch: feat/v23-followup-tasks (HEAD: f82fb48)
Target: main (at d5acd07)
Monorepo Test Telemetry: 260 Java tests passed (was 256), 47 Python tests passed, 68 Android tests passed (was 48), Cargo TUI passed, Vite Svelte 5 passed.

Summary of Prioritized Follow-Up Tasks Included in this Pack:
1. Task 1 (F7 Fixed Arbitrage Baseline): Preserves pre-drawdown liquid baseline across escalating/refiring tranches rather than compounding down against depleted balances (BucketEngine, TriggerHistoryRepository).
2. Task 2 (F10 Benchmark Fail Loud): Replaces silent 0% disarm with strict requireValidDrawdownPct throwing IllegalStateException mapped to HTTP 500 PIPELINE_DEGRADED on missing/non-positive 52w peak or live levels (PortfolioConstants, RebalanceTriggerEvaluator, GlobalExceptionHandler).
3. Task 3 (F5 Section 70 Netting Lot DTO Alignment): Prorates statutory post-netting tax liabilities back to liquidating lot DTOs and sets lossOffsetApplied: true on offset lots, reconciling lot-level estimatedTaxDrag with summary projected tax (RebalanceWaterfallEngine, RebalancePlanDtos, RebalancePlanEngine).
4. Task 4 (F11 Config-Driven Gold Drift): Versioned drift_trigger_pct: 5.0 and band_pct: 2.0 in bucket_targets.yaml schema v2.3, parsed via BucketConfigLoader (bucket_targets.yaml, BucketConfigLoader, RebalanceTriggerEvaluator).
5. Tasks 5 & 6 (Repository Overloads & Constructor Injection): Removed fragile JSON string sniffing from TriggerHistoryRepository; injected TriggerHistoryRepository into RebalanceController and removed heap fallback allocations in SyncController.
6. Task 7 (Mobile Parity Audit): Standardized Section 55(2)(ac) grandfathered FMV logic in LocalTradeSimulator.kt: max(cost, min(fmv, saleNav)) matching Core Node Lot.java bit-for-bit, verified across 20-scenario parameterized parity test suite (LocalTradeSimulator.kt, LocalTradeSimulatorParityTest.kt).

Included Files: All 23 modified production and test files plus key reference domain models (Lot.java, TaxRulesConfig.java, SyncModels.kt).
